plugin.name: depthdeck
plugin._long: Arranges windows into a depth deck: the focused window sits in front at full scale, the ones behind shrink and dim by focus depth.

option.name: enabled
option._long: Master switch. When disabled, every transformed window is unwound back to full scale and opacity.

option.name: layer_1_scale
option._long: Scale of the first card behind the focused one.

option.name: layer_1_opacity
option._long: Opacity of the first card behind the focused one.

option.name: layer_2_scale
option._long: Scale of the second card behind the focused one.

option.name: layer_2_opacity
option._long: Opacity of the second card behind the focused one.

option.name: max_layers
option._long: Number of depth levels over which the falloff interpolates down to the floor (scale 0.22 / opacity 0.05).
